Acute eosinophilic pneumonia often requires hospitalization and treatment with corticosteroids, while chronic eosinophilic pneumonia can often be managed with outpatient treatment
Pulmonary edema is a condition in which fluid accumulates in the lungs, often due to heart failure or high altitude, while COPD is a chronic respiratory condition caused by lung damage
Pulmonary edema can be life-threatening and requires immediate medical attention, while COPD is a chronic condition that requires ongoing management and treatment
